description: p15A origin as carried by the pSU vectors (pSU38 family): the 524 bp from the RNA II promoter -10 to the RNA-to-DNA transition. The p15A fragment of these vectors starts 21 bp into the RNA II promoter, so the -35 comes from vector DNA. Otherwise identical to the p15A part, except that it lacks the base V00309 flags as a conflict (662).

provenance.sequence_source: p15A origin as found in pSU38 (Bartolome et al. 1991); bases V00309 239-763 without V00309 base 662 (a conflict flagged in the deposit), = pACYC184 X06403 848-1372 without base 945 (reverse complement). No point mutations against pACYC184: the old description's 'several point mutations' was not borne out by alignment. Re-delimited (2026-11) from 789 bp: the old part also carried 265 bp past the RNA-to-DNA transition (V00309 764-1026, plus 2 bp not in V00309 or X06403).

functional_claims.label: Spans V00309 239-763: from the RNA II promoter -10 (the pSU38 fragment's own 5' end; its -35 is vector DNA) to the RNA-to-DNA transition, the base before the three replication start nucleotides V00309 764-766 (Selzer et al. 1983), as for the p15A part.

value.start: RNA II promoter -10 (end of the pSU38 p15A fragment)

source.quote: In each system, replication initiates at any of three consecutive nucleotides located at a unique site.

provenance.from: pairwise alignment to GenBank V00309, X06403 and the lab's pSU38Delta map
